findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 56 requests to 19 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).

4 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: amplitude.com (Amplitude, analytics), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), scorecardresearch.com (Comscore, audience measurement), taboola.com (Taboola, advertising).
The main document response did not include a Strict-Transport-Security header.
